components.name: Insight
components.scope: Existing bounded source-linked screening, dossier verification and plaintext Nova-Seed draft generation. It ranks supplied assessments; it does not independently discover or authenticate their truth.

components.name: FusionPlan
components.scope: Existing exact JobSpec validation, Ethereum Keccak commitments, ordered Merkle proofs and verification.

components.name: NovaSeed
components.scope: Inspected canonical contract binding capsuleHash, planRoot, evidenceHash, parent and creator. Research uses unminted artifacts; no contract transaction is executed.

components.name: MARK
components.scope: Inspected canonical funding/activation/routing rules. No capital, trade, mint, bloom or route is authorized or executed.

components.name: MARK inspection codec
components.scope: Existing bounded ABI and workflow descriptions; only local artifact inspection and read-call encoding are applicable.

components.name: MARK qualification
components.scope: Existing qualification boundary must refuse a research artifact claiming a qualified public campaign.

components.name: TrustRegistry
components.scope: Existing configured-role signature checking can bind a local research manifest; no live ENS or external organization is inferred.

components.name: TransformationLibrary
components.scope: Existing supported local structural scope; new research capability does not silently acquire network admission.

authority: read-only inspection and local research execution; no live chain action, publisher, registry or native scope change
